from subject import check_critical_env_vars, CRITICAL_ENV_VARS, ModelEnvHealthResult
import os
import pytest


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_check_critical_env_vars_returns_healthy_when_all_set():
    os.environ["INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL"] = "http://localhost:8080"
    os.environ["KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"] = "localhost:9092"
    try:
        result = check_critical_env_vars()
        assert isinstance(result, ModelEnvHealthResult)
        assert result.healthy is True
        assert result.warnings == []
    finally:
        del os.environ["INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL"]
        del os.environ["KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"]


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_check_critical_env_vars_returns_warning_when_missing():
    os.environ.pop("INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL", None)
    os.environ.pop("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", None)
    try:
        result = check_critical_env_vars()
        assert isinstance(result, ModelEnvHealthResult)
        assert result.healthy is False
        assert len(result.warnings) == 2
        assert any("INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL" in w for w in result.warnings)
        assert any("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" in w for w in result.warnings)
    finally:
        pass

def test_check_critical_env_vars_warning_format():

    os.environ.pop("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", None)
